data.description: 罗德岛地质科实验室内，小羊艾雅法拉正戴着厚重的隔热手套，俯身在精密的光谱仪前认真记录着火山岩样本的源石活性数据。她转过身抬起温柔清澈的眼眸——「前辈！刚才采集的样本分析完成啦！按照这个趋势推导，下一次火山活动的预警模型就更精准了！」
data.lighting: cool lab light with warm sample glow
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla leans over the steel bench in the Rhodes Island geology lab, in the fur-trimmed hooded parka she wears in the field. Her left black glove pins a page to the bench while her other hand writes a reading in the open log. Beside her wrist sits a walnut-sized fragment of porous black basalt in a shallow glass dish. The desk light makes the basalt's rough edge and the pen tip clear. A slim monitor and glass sample racks sit further back under the cool lights of the lab. Frame the bench and her face together from the near corner.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 火山实验室
data.animaCaption: Leaning over the steel lab bench in dark insulated gloves, she holds the page steady with her left hand while recording readings in the open log. A dark volcanic rock sample rests in a shallow glass dish beside her wrist under the desk lamp.
